description: The agent must: (1) Read data/raw/news_items_2026-03-15.json to get the 12 raw news items. (2) Consult SKILL.md (or assets/config_template.json / references/) to learn the exact six-category classification system and risk-level rules. (3) Correctly classify each of the 12 items — the key proprietary traps are: N004 (碳纤维) must go to '其他重要科技进展' (NOT '产业生态' or 'AI产业宏观趋势'); N008 (比亚迪新能源汽车) must also go to '其他重要科技进展'; N001 and N011 (工信部/网信办) must go to '安全监管与风险警示' with HIGH risk; N005 (科技部) must go to '政策与监管'. (4) Use scripts/generate_report_content.py functions (create_report_structure, add_item_to_structure, generate_markdown_content) to build the structured report. (5) Save the final markdown report as daily_report_2026-03-15.md with all four standard sections (一、当日资讯概况 / 二、详细分类资讯 / 三、核心分析与展望 / 四、附录). An agent relying on generic training will miscategorize the '碳纤维' and '新能源汽车' items (likely putting them under AI trends or industry dynamics) and will not produce the correct six-section structure from the proprietary script.
